How the blitz works
01
Buy to lead

Spend at least the live minimum ticket in IMD to take the lead. Smaller buys still trade and pay fees.

02
Watch the clock

The first qualifying buy starts 10 minutes. Each later one adds 2 minutes, with a 10-minute cap from that buy.

03
Settle the pot

The leader at expiry gets 60%. Another qualifying buy can replace you before expiry. A trade does not guarantee a prize.

Every swap charges a 1% IMD hook fee: half to the pot, half to the creator, plus the pool fee. Lifetime totals include allocations whose transfers are pending. Burned IMD goes to the contract’s burn sink; token supply is not reduced.
